## Type

- [ ] Content (patterns, terms, philosophy, rules, videos, evidence)
- [ ] Shell / interface
- [ ] Docs / decisions
- [ ] Tests / tooling

## Checklist

- [ ] Built with `python3 build.py` and committed `dist/index.html`
- [ ] `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` passes
- [ ] `python3 tests/smoke_test.py` passes
- [ ] Every new content item has a source (`src`) and a lineage label
- [ ] Nothing copyrighted is reproduced (paraphrase plus citation only)
- [ ] Any claim about benefits matches an evidence-registry entry
- [ ] Hash routes and `dj_*` storage keys are unchanged (or a migration and test are included)
- [ ] Decision log updated if scope, rights, data or philosophy changed
